Privacy Policy

How AutixAI handles enquiries, local drafts, privacy choices and information requests.

Updated 8 October 2026

Who to contact

Business brand
AutixAI
Contact
+91 96173 10042

AutixAI provides business automation and workflow integration services. The contracting party and any applicable registration, tax and billing details must be identified in the written proposal before a paid project begins.

What we collect and why

The enquiry form asks for your name, business, industry, a phone number or email, and the process you want to automate. Workload and current tools are optional. Information you choose to send is used to answer your enquiry, prepare an audit and discuss or deliver an agreed project. The privacy-request form asks only for a contact detail, request type and optional context. Avoid passwords, API keys, payment details, health information and confidential customer or employee records.

Preparing or sending an enquiry does not subscribe you to a mailing list. There is currently no newsletter sign-up or marketing-email service on this website. You can request that promotional contact stop using the request form below.

You review before anything is sent

Enquiry and privacy-request drafts are prepared locally. No form details are sent to an AutixAI backend or saved in browser storage by this website. Opening WhatsApp passes the draft to WhatsApp; you review and tap Send there. If an enquiry service is connected, a separate direct-send button appears after review, with an updated notice. Only choosing that button sends the enquiry directly. Preparing a draft never books a call or takes payment.

Reloading or leaving the page clears the website’s in-memory draft. Your browser may independently offer autofill or form restoration. Once you actually send a message, copies may exist in the messaging service and the recipient’s records.

The guided assistant and demos

The assistant uses pre-written conversational branches, not a live AI model. Messages, selections and audit fields stay in the current page’s memory. Closing the panel retains them in that page; Reset, reload, navigation or closing the tab clears them. There is no chat history in browser storage and no AI provider or chat backend receives the conversation.

An assistant audit uses only the editable business, process, tool and contact fields you review. It does not include the full transcript. The calculator and workflow demos run locally and do not connect to your business tools.

Cookies, optional analytics and hosting

No advertising tracker or analytics service is currently enabled. Optional analytics events are blocked unless analytics is configured and you explicitly allow it. A consent choice, when optional analytics is enabled, is stored locally for up to 180 days; it contains only the choice, date and notice version. Enquiry, privacy-request and assistant text are never included. Decorative-motion choices last only in the current page.

Read Cookies & Privacy Choices or . Vercel hosts this site and may process request information such as IP addresses and logs under its Privacy Notice. Fonts and website media are served with the site.

External services and recipients

WhatsApp applies its own privacy policies. Instagram links open Instagram; the page does not embed an Instagram feed. A configured calendar link opens the named booking provider. These services may process data in other countries under their own terms. AutixAI does not control their separate records. Any additional service required for a paid project, its access and data responsibilities must be agreed in the project scope.

Retention and deletion

Drafts and chat have the short page-memory lifetime described above. Information you send to AutixAI is handled separately as enquiry, project or business records. Retention depends on the enquiry, the agreed project and applicable record-keeping obligations; a single fixed retention period for those records has not been set. You can ask what is held and request deletion below. We will review the request and explain any information that must be retained and why. A request to AutixAI does not delete the separate records of WhatsApp, Vercel or another provider.

Children and sensitive information

This website offers services to businesses and does not ask for dates of birth or children’s data. Do not include children’s personal information in enquiries, assistant messages or demo examples. If such information was sent by mistake, contact us using the request form. Any project involving children’s or sensitive data requires a separate assessment before access or development.

Your information. Your request.

Ask about information you sent us, request a copy or correction, request deletion, or ask us to stop promotional contact. You can also call +91 96173 10042. We may need to verify your connection to an enquiry before sharing or changing records. Do not send identity documents, passwords or customer records here.
